Setup Guide

This guide provides step-by-step instructions for installing and running PlaViSca locally. For online access, visit PlaViSca Web Application.

System Requirements

  • Operating System: macOS, Windows, or Linux

  • R Version: 4.3.3 (tested) (Download R)

  • RStudio: 2024.09 or later (recommended) (Download RStudio)

  • Git: 2.43 or later (Download Git)

  • RAM: 16 GB minimum

  • CPU: 4 cores minimum

  • Disk Space: 5 GB free

Environment Snapshot (current)

The live app was run with the following versions:

  • R: 4.3.3

  • renv: 1.1.5

  • Core packages: DT (0.34.0), later (1.4.5), memoise (2.0.1), plotly (4.11.0), RColorBrewer (1.1-3), readr (2.1.6), shiny (1.12.1), shinycssloaders (1.1.0), shinyjs (2.1.1), tibble (3.3.1), tidyverse (2.0.0), viridis (0.6.5)

If you restore with renv, these exact versions will be installed automatically.

Installation Steps

PlaViSca is compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems. Follow the steps below to set up the application on your system.

1. Clone the Repository

git clone https://github.com/Sopheap15/PlaViSca.git

This will create a directory named PlaViSca containing the application files.

2. Install Dependencies

Recommended (matched to this project):

# inside the project folder
install.packages("renv")
renv::restore()

This installs the exact package versions listed above. If you prefer a minimal install without renv, use:

install.packages(c("shiny", "shinyjs", "shinycssloaders", "plotly", "DT", "RColorBrewer", "tidyverse", "later", "memoise", "viridis", "readr", "tibble"))

3. Run the Application

Option A: Using the provided helper script (Linux/macOS)

We have provided a bash script to make running the application easier, especially on servers.

# Run and make it accessible from other machines
./run_app.sh --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3838

Common options:

  • -h, --host: Set the host IP (default: 0.0.0.0).

  • -p, --port: Set the port number (default: 3838).

  • -b, --browser: Enable auto-opening the browser (default is disabled to avoid errors on servers).

Option B: Using RStudio (Desktop)

  1. Then, open a web browser on your local machine and go to: http://<server-ip>:3838

  2. Replace <server-ip> with the actual IP address of your server. You can find it with:

hostname -I

The application will launch in your default web browser (or be accessible remotely if running on a server).

Troubleshooting

If you encounter issues during installation or running the app, refer to the following common problems and solutions:

  • App fails with browser error: If you see Error in utils::browseURL(appUrl) : 'browser' must be a non-empty character string, it means R is trying to open a browser in an environment without one (like a remote server). Use ./run_app.sh (which disables browser by default) or add launch.browser=FALSE to your runApp command.

  • Missing packages: If renv::restore() fails or you see “package not found” errors, ensure you have the necessary system libraries installed (see point above). You can also try R -e "renv::status()" to identify which packages are missing.

  • Data not loading: Verify that data files are placed in the data/ directory with the correct names and formats (see User Manual for details).

  • Browser issues: Clear your browser cache or try a different browser. Ensure JavaScript is enabled.

  • Performance issues: PlaViSca requires at least 16 GB RAM. Close other applications if needed.

  • Package installation errors: On Linux, you may need to install system libraries (e.g., sudo apt-get install libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev libxml2-dev).

For additional help contact the development team.
